findings.text: follow-on: the base and head roadmap and audit arms are byte-identical because reckon's sprint items are bare slug strings, so the real-data control discriminates string-shape regressions only and the widened slug-then-path mapping rests on the unit test and its negative control alone.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified 6 production call site(s): reckon/_store.py:2805 and :3256, reckon/doccheck.py:607, reckon/roadmap.py:1500, reckon/mcp_discovery.py:653 and the re-export reckon/mcp.py:202.
item_verdicts.diff: read 69043115a..37ab7441 commit by commit; one commit moves the four private slug readers into reckon/_store.py:2462 and imports it in the three callers, adds tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is a grep finding one definition plus tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py EXIT=0 plus identical masked roadmap/audit at base and head plus an importer delta plus a negative control; gate.node.txt records 8 passed, negative_control.txt ends EXIT=1, diff.masked.txt reads IDENTICAL, and git diff --numstat over reckon/ is -17.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is "Read a sprint item's plan slug through one helper in the store module"; reckon/_store.py:2462 defines sprint_item_slug and doccheck.py:607, roadmap.py:1500 and mcp_discovery.py:653 reach it, so every reader now reads the slug through one helper.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 37ab7441, all six changed_paths inside the fence, tests names the head gate and result, baseline_suite and after_suite are populated with their logs, negative_control_log is set to the red log's bare path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; git diff --numstat 69043115a..37ab7441 touches only reckon/_store.py, reckon/doccheck.py, reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/mcp_discovery.py, tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the fence.

justifications.durability: negative_control.txt reddens test_reads_a_path_mapping and test_blank_slug_falls_through_to_path when reckon/_store.py:2462 is mutated to ignore the path key, so the guard is verified by reinstating the regression rather than by a green suite.
justifications.evidence: gate.node.txt records tests/test_one_sprint_item_slug.py 8 passed EXIT=0 and negative_control.txt ends EXIT=1, both re-read, but suite.base.log and suite.head.log both stamp revision 69043115a so the head arm's revision label is the base rather than 37ab7441.
justifications.fit: reckon/_store.py:2462 follows the module's existing Mapping/Any idiom and its public name matches the doccheck helper it replaces, with no plan or ticket identifier in any symbol, comment or fragment id.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_store.py:2462 is the single definition and doccheck.py:607, roadmap.py:1500 and mcp_discovery.py:653 import it, so every reader of the slug now reaches one helper in the store module.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the lowest-layer owner of the capability at reckon/_store.py:2462 and deletes the three private copies, so no capability the repository owns is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --numstat 69043115a..37ab7441 touches only the declared reckon modules, the test and the fragment, leaving the declared figures directory unused as a done-when with no named artifact requires.
